title: FR-03 Financial KYC Submission and Review
classNote: Selected financial KYC members. ID photo references live in CollaboratorProfile.socialLinksJson, bank details in its fields. Legacy reviewKyc allows Shop/Admin/Manager and delegates to reviewKolApplication; the shared UI uses Admin-only routes. Upload, DTO, social channel and Shop-onboarding details: FR03_CODE_ANALYSIS.md.
subtitle: Current UI: KOL submits CCCD, tax and bank details → Admin reviews. Shop review is allowed by the legacy API; the shared Shop UI calls Admin-only routes.

notes: Browser groups KycSubmissionPage (KOL) and KycApprovalPage (reviewer) in separate authenticated sessions. JWT/role guards run before controller calls; DTO checks precede methods. Expanded case: existing COLLABORATOR profile and Wallet. Initial GET/profile and refresh calls are summarized.

ID photos: separate upload to Cloudinary, with FileReader Data URL fallback. References are saved in socialLinksJson. Form requires tax/bank/channel data; bank fields are optional in SubmitKycDto. No automatic tax/bank verification is shown.

Missing profile is created by submitKyc. New/rejected submissions become UNVERIFIED; editing a VERIFIED profile keeps VERIFIED. UNVERIFIED plus submitted ID is displayed as pending, not a separate database PENDING status. Social channel synchronization is awaited after profile persistence.

Legacy admin/pending and admin/:id/review allow Shop/Admin/Manager. Shared UI instead calls admin/applications and admin/kol/:id/review (Admin/Manager only): ordinary Shop receives 403. Shop approval through the legacy API is separate from that UI.

Profile not found: 404. VERIFIED promotes CUSTOMER to COLLABORATOR and creates Wallet only if absent; REJECTED sends KOL_REJECTED. These branches are summarized. KOL writes are sequential, with no transaction or approval AuditLog in this method.

Legacy reviewKyc delegates to reviewKolApplication but drops dto.note; non-VERIFIED maps to REJECTED. Bank fields belong to Profile, Wallet to User. Rejection does not remove role/Wallet. Shop onboarding and FR07 are separate; see FR03_CODE_ANALYSIS.md.
